title: Threshold Graphs Allow Few Distinct Eigenvalues: A New Approach
summary: For any graph $G$, we associate a family of real symmetric matrices, $S(G)$, where for any $A \in S(G)$, the location of the nonzero off-diagonal entries of $A$ are governed by the adjacency structure of $G$. Let $q(G)$ represent the minimum number of distinct eigenvalues over all matrices in $S(G)$. In this work, we provide an alternative technique to establish that $q(G) \leq 4$ for any threshold graph $G$ as presented in [L. Emilio Allem, C. Hoppen, J. Lazzarin, L. Siviero Sibemberg, F.
